senses.gloss: hair-crown (cmp. כְּלִילָא), front hair from temple to temple.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:4">Sabb. VIII, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 78b:1">78ᵇ</cite>) <he>כדי לעשות כ׳</he> (Bab. ed. <he>כלכל</he>; Ms. M. <he>כדי לסוד כי׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) enough to produce a crown by depilation of undergrowth. Ib. 80ᵇ, v. <cite ref="A02115"><he>אַנְדִּיפֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 1:1">ib. I, 1</cite> <he>הריני מכלכל</he>) how do we know <he>דהאי כ׳ שערו הוא</he> that this vow refers to letting the hair grow?—
Nidd. 52ᵇ; Tosef. ib. VI, 6 (ref. to the hair around the pudenda as evidence of maturity) כ׳ זה איני יודע (מהו) about this kilkul I know nothing.

senses.gloss: support, sustenance. Naz. l. c. אימא מיזן עניי I may say that the kilkul (of the Mishnah, v. supra) means supporting the poor.
